name: aio-jev-hint
description: Author a UserPromptSubmit hook + `.jev-hint` catalog file that classifies every user prompt against a JSON catalog of {name, useWhen, context} entries via a batched LLM boolean-question call (Vercel AI SDK experimental_evaluate, model typesafe-ai/jev), then injects matched entries as additionalContext when confidence clears a threshold. Covers hook mechanics (fail-open, stdin payload, catalog resolution, batching, debug logging) and .jev-hint field-writing best practices distilled from real production tuning.
